The railway ministry today announced that 17 persons had been killed and 7 seriously injured in an explosion aboard a train near Oita, Kysushu prefecture. The explosion was officially attributed to dyna dynamite, - mite, dynamite, which was believed somehow to have become mixed in the coal used by the engine. All the dead were passengers. A majority of the 17 apparently lived for several hours after the explosion. The blast started a forest fire, which burned throughout the night. Police and followers of Mahatma Gandhi engaged in a scuffle on the beach this morning while volunteers engaged in th-» civil disobedience campaign were collecting salt in defiance of the government monopoly. Police arrested the captain of the volunteers and others. Two Nationalists were reported slightly injured. Gandhi, who opened the civil disobedience campaign himself yesterday, arrived shortly after the scuffle.
